about:
Alaska Spiritwear LLC, operating under the FishAK brand, is based in Anchorage, Alaska. The company sells branded apparel and accessories through its e-commerce site AlaskanShirts.com, offering a range of Alaska-themed designs on t-shirts, hoodies, hats, drinkware, and lanyards.

The product catalog includes tri-blend adult and youth t-shirts, midweight hoodies, Richardson trucker hats, UPF 50 long-sleeve shirts, stainless-steel tumblers, and retractable lanyards. Orders are fulfilled and shipped via USPS Ground Advantage to minimize shipping costs, and the physical shop opens only on Tuesdays during the annual Alaska State Fair.

The business serves individual consumers seeking Alaska-inspired lifestyle merchandise, with designs referencing local fishing culture, hockey, and humorous slogans. There is no indication of wholesale, contract manufacturing, or B2B supply arrangements in the available information.

No founding year, ownership structure, or stated mission beyond selling Alaska-themed goods is provided in the source material.
